The response integrates theory, mechanisms and specific evidence across a broad range of factors. Statements such as 'Lower protection lets countries specialise according to comparative advantage' and 'This has allowed transnational corporations to fragment production into global value chains' clearly explain integration rather than merely listing its features. Uneven development and peripheral statistical inaccuracies place it towards the lower end of the top band.

Accurate statistical definitions make your supporting evidence more convincing. Next mark: Correct the global value chain statistic and clarify the price basis and period of the world GDP figures.
